Sub: Audio recording of earnings conference call held on May 21, 2026 
 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
This is in continuation of our intimation dated May 15, 2026, regarding the schedule of earnings conference call 
of Embassy Developments Limited (“the Company”) to discuss the operational and financial performance of the 
Company for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026. 
 
We hereby inform that the said earnings conference call was held today at the scheduled time and, in 
compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, 
as amended, the audio recording of the aforesaid earnings conference call has been made available on the 
website of the Company at the following link: 
 
Click here: EDL Earnings Conference Call Recording Q4FY2026 
 
We further wish to inform that at around the 39:50 timestamp of this earnings conference call, during the course 
of the discussion regarding the debt conversion, a statement was made to the effect that “the price of share 
today is still low and we are waiting for the market to correct, both the market to correct as well as the share 
price to correct”. 
 
In this regard, it is clarified that the management’s intention was to convey that the prevailing share price levels 
are presently low from the perspective of any potential equity conversion and corresponding dilution. 
Accordingly, the reference to the share price “to be corrected” was intended to mean improvement in the share 
price and reaching appropriate, fair and “correct” valuation levels for such dilution. 
 
Kindly take the same on record. 
 
Thank you 
Yours truly, 
For Embassy Developments Limited 
(Formerly Equinox India Developments Limited 
and earlier Indiabulls Real Estate Limited) 
 
 
 
Vikas Khandelwal 
Company Secretary 
Vikas
